written_at: 2026-10-15, committed before any candidate was scored
scale: Each criterion is scored 0-5 against the anchors below, then multiplied by weight/5. Total out of 100. Totals are computed by score.mjs, never by hand.

criteria.rule: ESTIMATE net $/month from baseline.json numbers × an attach rate taken from research.md; inputs must be shown

anchors.4: flow exists, needs a fee/charge hook

anchors.2: touches charge path behind a flag

anchors.0: contradicts signals or adds floor work
anchors.5: 2+ strong signals, no added floor work

criteria.rule: must be readable from a Phase 0 verified source

disqualifiers: D1 changes existing behaviour when the flag is off
D2 needs customer PII to leave the system
D3 makes the staff app slower or less reliable offline
D4 cannot be measured with data verified in Phase 0
